name: Constancy
overview: Scripture highlights constancy as steadfast loyalty and perseverance in various aspects of the believer's life. Ruth's unwavering commitment to Naomi exemplifies faithfulness in relationships, while Psalms 119 calls for enduring obedience to God's statutes and testimonies. Proverbs urges believers to maintain close, dependable friendships, especially in times of trouble. Additionally, Jesus teaches the importance of persistent prayer despite challenges, encouraging believers not to faint but to remain faithful under suffering and in spiritual disciplines.
